newsitem.title: USA: UAW to make announcement on GM strike.
newsitem.headline: UAW to make announcement on GM strike.

text.p: United Auto Workers Local 594 said Wednesday it will make an announcement at 1800 EDT regarding negotiations in the nearly three-month-old strike at General Motors Corp.'s Pontiac, Mich., truck assembly plant.
"There'll be a news announcement at six o'clock," said Jim Abare, a Local 594 officer.
The scheduling of the press conference comes amid increasing signs of progress in talks to end one of the longest local strikes in GM's history.
Earlier Wednesday, GM Chief Financial Officer J. Michael Losh said he believed the strike would be resolved soon, because bargainers "are down to a very few issues."

The Pontiac strike and a second walkout at GM's Oklahoma City car plant contributed to a $490 million reduction in GM's second quarter profit. The automaker earned $2.1 billion during the April-June period, up from $1.9 billion in the second quarter of 1996.
